meta.headline_recommendation: Two-Stage Sequence: (1) Open a 90-Day Early 'Blend-and-Extend' Inquiry Now to Lock in a 15-Year Lease Reset; (2) Sell Into an IRC §1031 Like-Kind Exchange While >=6 Years of Term Remain (Whether Extended or Unextended) — Never Hold Passively Into the Final 3–4 Years of the 2030–2035 Expiry Window.

strategies.title: Stage 1: Early Blend-and-Extend (2026–27) -> Stage 2: IRC §1031 Exchange Sale (2027–28)
strategies.summary: Extending the lease early back to 12–15 years compresses the exit cap rate from ~6.95% to ~6.40% (S13), creating +13.3% of instant value uplift before rotating 100% tax-deferred via IRC §1031 (S19) into a diversified multi-property portfolio.

strategies.verdict: RECOMMENDED IMMEDIATE FALLBACK (IF TENANT DECLINES EXTENSION OR EXPIRY IS 2030–2031)
strategies.title: Sell Pre-Cliff Now via IRC §1031 Like-Kind Exchange (Without Waiting for Expiry)
strategies.wealth_preservation_score: 5 / 5 (Highest immediate tail-risk protection; avoids WALT <6-yr cliff)
strategies.growth_opportunity_score: 4 / 5 (Captures 7.1%–7.4% replacement yield vs ~1.5% in-place rent bumps)
strategies.summary: If the lease expires in 2030–2031 (only 4–5 years left) or if the tenant refuses an early extension within 90 days, sell immediately via IRC §1031 while buyer financing is still available.

strategies.verdict: CONDITIONAL HOLD (ONLY IF STORE RENT-TO-SALES <= 8% & CORPORATE GUARANTY)
strategies.title: Hold Single Asset Through 2030–2035 Expiry & Renew at Market Rate to 2040
strategies.wealth_preservation_score: 2 / 5 (100% exposed to LA earthquake, wildfire insurance shock & JACK closures)
strategies.growth_opportunity_score: 3 / 5 (Preserves Prop 13 2% tax cap, but exposed to 28% non-renewal TI/vacancy)
strategies.summary: Preserves the low Prop 13 tax base (S17), but leaves 100% of owner wealth concentrated in a single aging QSR pad facing -4.2% brand SSS, $20/hr AB 1228 labor compression, and 60% 30-yr M>=6.7 seismic hazard.

strategies.title: Hold Unextended Until Final Year of Lease (2030–2035), Then Sell
strategies.wealth_preservation_score: 2 / 5 (Suffers full WALT cap-rate expansion to ~8.15%+ at exit)
strategies.growth_opportunity_score: 2 / 5 (Loses ~18%–24% of asset value to term decay)
strategies.summary: Letting remaining term decay to 1–2 years before selling forces a disposition into an all-cash/value-add buyer pool at an ~8.15%+ cap rate, destroying the net-lease premium.

strategies.title: Sell Now Outright in a Taxable Cash Transaction (No §1031 Exchange)
strategies.wealth_preservation_score: 3 / 5 (Eliminates property risk but permanently destroys ~26.5%–37.1% of capital)
strategies.growth_opportunity_score: 1 / 5 (Shrunken post-tax principal cannot compound to match §1031 or hold)
strategies.summary: Paying combined Federal LTCG + NIIT (23.8%), §1250 Recapture (28.8%), and California income tax (up to 13.3%) on a low-basis property permanently erodes over a quarter of family wealth (S19).

triggers.trigger: Remaining Primary Lease Term (WALT) vs. 6.0-Year Financing Cliff
triggers.threshold: If expiry is 2030 or 2031 (<5.5 yrs left) -> Sell/Extend immediately in Q1 2027; if 2033–2035 (7–9 yrs left) -> Negotiate Blend-and-Extend first
triggers.why: Lenders curtail 10-year amortizing debt once WALT drops below 6 years, widening cap rates by 75–175 bps.

triggers.trigger: Store-Level Rent-to-Sales Coverage Ratio (Gross Sales Audit)
triggers.threshold: <= 8.5% = Strong renewal candidate | 8.5%–10.5% = Watchlist | >= 11.0% = High closure/rent-cut risk -> Sell via §1031
triggers.why: With $20/hr AB 1228 wages (S09) and -4.2% YTD SSS (S12), stores above 10.5% occupancy cost are prime targets for 'JACK on Track' closure.

triggers.trigger: Reinvestment Yield Spread on IRC §1031 Replacement Assets
triggers.threshold: Replacement net cash yield >= 6.68% beats passive holding in Base case (Verified REIT benchmark = 7.30%–7.40%)
triggers.why: At >=6.68% replacement yield, tax-deferred §1031 compounding outperforms holding a 1.5%-escalating lease in a +3.7% CPI market.

triggers.threshold: 10–15 yr extension compressing exit cap by >=50 bps (6.95% -> 6.40%) creates +$191k of value per $100k NOI (+13.3%)
triggers.why: Captures the institutional 10+ year WALT buyer tier documented in NNN REIT's FY2025 Form 10-K (6.4% disposition cap, S13).

triggers.trigger: City of Los Angeles Measure ULA $5,400,000 Gross Sale Price Cliff
triggers.threshold: If parcel is inside City of LA and valued between $5.40M and $5.68M -> Price at $5.39M to save ~$216,000+ in ULA surtax
triggers.why: Measure ULA adds a 4.0% gross tax on the entire sale price once consideration exceeds $5,400,000 post-July 1, 2026 (S18).

triggers.trigger: Proposition 13 Reassessment Pass-Through Impact on Tenant Occupancy Cost
triggers.threshold: If post-sale Prop 13 tax reassessment (1.0% + bonds on FMV) pushes tenant total occupancy cost >10% of store sales -> Extend lease before marketing
triggers.why: Buyers underwrite the reassessment tax jump billed to the NNN tenant; locking in the tenant's extension first removes buyer re-leasing discount.
